summary: City page read: 14 sites with electric and water hookups, showers, dump, first come; $30 a night ($175/week, $600/month) confirmed; hookups.water added. Not waterfront kept (loop road and trees between the sites and the small lake). The city posts no season.
flags: Waterfront: keep not waterfront. On imagery the sites ring a gravel loop among trees east of Swift Lake's east lobe; the loop road and a tree band lie between the sites and the water (~40-60 m), and the lake itself is small (on the order of 5-8 ha on imagery).
Pin 44.24625,-95.60540 is at the park-road junction ~90 m SW of the campground loop (about 44.2465,-95.6044): OK under 250 m.
Phone 507-629-5528 is Tracy City Hall (city page footer); no separate campground number is posted. Website is the city's campground page (answers 200).
Long-stay: the city sells $600 monthly stays beside the $30 nightly rate, first come; a public city campground with 14 sites, not read as seasonal-lease.
Season not stated on the city page; left unset.
Note unchanged (it says nothing a field shows).
